purpose: Record the guarded one-request TaskManager initData/computed repair probe and its post-run semantic audit
resolved_early_parent_write: The candidate removed this.data.set('tasks', this.getSampleTasks()) from the exported parent's inited() and retained attached() -> loadInitialData().
unresolved_semantic_risk: Source Vue TaskForm data() initializes formData from this.createFormData(this.task) on first creation. The candidate San TaskForm initData() now returns an empty/default formData object, and inited() only registers a task watcher; it does not set formData from the initial this.data.get('task'). Editing a task when the conditional modal first mounts therefore starts with a blank form until a later task prop change. The current static and visual evaluators do not establish equivalence for this path.
isolated_san_runtime_check: A read-only Node/San instance check passed initial task.title='existing' in constructor data and registered the same task watcher in inited(); formData.title remained ''. The watcher did not initialize from the existing prop.
conclusion: The probe resolves the two reported static failures and the early parent state write, but its reported automatic pass is not accepted as semantic equivalence. Add a bounded prop-derived initial-state check/repair, then rerun a fresh development-set batch before manual review. This result is not independent formal-test evidence.
